SAFFIRE-I  Image Directory Nomenclature
Xn_Raw_CamOriginal
RAW Camera Original - contains 8 byte offset that must be corrected prior 
to color interpolation.  
Xn_Raw_DistroMaster
RAW Distribution Master - 8 byte offset corrected using ImageJ.  Use this 
file set to distribute RAW image files and color interpolation processing. 
Xn_Raw2TIFF
RAW_DistroMaster files color interpolated and saved as TIFF, using 
IrfanView Batch Conversion process.  
Xn_Raw2TIFF_icmad
Raw2TIFF files annotated with ICMAD 'Exposure' and 'Gain' information.  
Data is appended to the bottom of each frame using ImageMagick script.  
Xn_jpeg
Flight hardware generated jpeg images, created on-board from the RAW 
Camera Original.  
Xn_jpeg_corrupt
Jpeg images received corrupted after downlink. 
Xn_jpeg2png_icmad
Flight hardware generated jpeg images annotated with ICMAD 'Exposure' 
and 'Gain' information.  Data is appended to the bottom of each frame 
using ImageMagick script and re-saved as .png format to prevent 
additional compression artifacts.  
"X" Denotes run type 
"n" Denotes run number
